ramCapacityReview.resolution: DFP 496 KiB omits fixed ITCM 64 KiB and backup 4 KiB. 192 KiB shared AXI/ITCM allocation is not additional memory; do not expose both allocation maxima simultaneously.

sourceAnomalies.resolution: Do not follow or silently repair the source alias. ST header DTCM_BASE_NS=0x20000000 and DTCM_BASE_S=0x30000000 distinguish DTCM from ITCM_BASE_NS=0x00000000 and ITCM_BASE_S=0x10000000. Manual relationship and RAM allocation still need review. Distinct bases alone do not establish physical backing; this is a suspect target, not a confirmed silicon mapping error.
